feedTtl.comment: How long a roll stays on the world feed at all — 600000 is ten minutes. The feed is a ticker, not a ledger: without this the 60-entry cap is the only thing that ever clears it, so on a quiet day the page still greets you with last week's rolls. A pull still holding its pin (feedPin) is never cut while it holds; it leaves with the next prune once its window is up. Staff announcements are not rolls, so they stay until the cap pushes them out — set keepAnnouncements false to sweep them on the same clock.

feedPin.comment: How long a pull holds the top of the world feed, by how rare it was. The entry keeps the highest tier it clears; when that window expires it just drops back into the chronological list.

feedTierBg.comment: World-feed rows at or above this 1-in-N get painted in their rarity tier colour instead of the plain row background.

freeAutoRoll.comment: Everyone gets this many auto-rolls per second for free. The Auto Roll upgrade stacks on top of it.

quickRoll.comment: The Quick Roll toggle (skip the roll animation) unlocks once the player has rolled this many times in their lifetime.
